name: chief-restart
effect: stops the operator's running chief session named <chief> (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after 15 s) and re-arms it from its handover doc <doc> with <repo>/scripts/handover/arm-resume.sh; the stale queue lock is taken over by the re-armed session. Runs as the operator user, never as root. A chief cannot restart itself: a request from the chief's own session is refused
